CCNA301V2-0000024.title: R1 NAT configuration
CCNA301V2-0000024.content:
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description Private LAN 10.10.10.0/24
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat outside
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description Internet uplink
 ip address 203.0.113.2 255.255.255.252
 ip nat inside
!
access-list 1 permit 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255
ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1 overload

CCNA301V2-0000026.title: Router ACL and interface configuration
CCNA301V2-0000026.content:
ip access-list extended WEB-IN
 10 permit tcp any host 10.10.10.50 eq 443
 20 deny ip any any
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description Internet-facing WAN
 ip address 203.0.113.2 255.255.255.252
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description Internal LAN
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group WEB-IN in

CCNA301V2-0000029.title: Ansible playbook
CCNA301V2-0000029.content:
- name: Collect access-switch interface status
  hosts: access_switches
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Run interface status command
      cisco.ios.ios_command:
        commands:
          - show interfaces status
      register: interface_status

    - name: Display returned lines
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: interface_status.stdout_lines
